remaining_limits: One embedded process, tenant and selected compiled model per store; serialized writers.

Calculation/equipment retain G2 4096-source/8192-output/16384-role limits and dated workload evidence. G3e exercised 64 sources each, so their population-overflow and retained-role-ceiling trials were not repeated.
Invoicing retains 64 sources/256 outputs/512 roles; no new capacity claim.
Mutation work remains 200000 units, with 64 commands, 32 returning IDs, 1024 active receipts and a 64 MiB backup ceiling; large causal closures may reject.
The native Linux x86_64 artifact needs glibc 2.38+, GNU loader, libgcc_s and libm; other hosts require compatible builds/checks.
No external money transfer, full accounting parity, quantity-return pricing, dated rational FX, arbitrary model loading, distributed adapter or frontend.
The selected goal verified loopback services and the deployment bundle; systemd host installation and public TLS endpoint provisioning were not requested or executed.
No sustained throughput, power-loss durability or unrestricted production capacity certification.
continuation: Selected G3d/G3e deployment goal complete. Use the deployment guide to run the bundle; new capability work enters a named bounded gate.
